entries.appliesTo: food retailers and third-party food delivery service providers (dynamic-pricing / personal-data prohibitions on tax-exempt food); merchants generally (algorithmic-pricing disclosure)

dutySources.disclosure-ui: § 13-322(C) — 'A CLEAR AND CONSPICUOUS DISCLOSURE WITH THE FOLLOWING' statement: 'THIS PRICE WAS SET BY AN ALGORITHM OR BY USING YOUR' PERSONAL DATA

sources.prohibition: § 13-321(B)(2) — a food retailer or third-party food delivery service provider may not 'ENGAGE IN DYNAMIC PRICING TO SET A HIGHER PRICE FOR' tax-exempt food, or 'USE SURVEILLANCE PERSONAL DATA TO SET A HIGHER' price; § 13-321(A)(3)(I) defines dynamic pricing 'INCLUDING THROUGH TH E USE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE' or models that retrain in near real-time
sources.disclosure: § 13-322(C) — 'A MERCHANT MAY NOT SET' the price of a consumer good or service using dynamic pricing or personal data and communicate the price unless it includes 'A CLEAR AND CONSPICUOUS DISCLOSURE WITH THE FOLLOWING' statement: 'THIS PRICE WAS SET BY AN ALGORITHM OR BY USING YOUR' PERSONAL DATA
sources.enforcer: § 13-321(D)(1) / § 13-322(D)(1) — before an enforcement action under Subtitle 4 of this title 'THE DIVISION SHALL ISSUE A' notice of violation; § 13-321(E) — 'MAY NOT BE CONSTRUED TO AUTH ORIZE A PRIVATE' right of action
sources.cureDays: § 13-321(D)(2) / § 13-322(D)(2) — 'THE DIVISION SHALL PROVIDE THE ALLEGED VIOLATOR 45 DAYS' after the notice of violation is received to cure the violation

flags: No penaltyMax: §§ 13-408 and 13-411 as amended each state 'THIS SECTION DOES NOT  APPLY TO A VIOLATION' of § 13-321 or § 13-322 — the title's private action and general $1,000 misdemeanor fine are expressly excluded for these sections; enforcement runs only through Division action under Subtitle 4

§ 13-321(C) additionally prohibits use of protected class data — 'MAY NOT USE PROTECTED CLASS DATA TO OFFER' , advertise, or sell where it has the effect of 'WITHHOLDING OR DENYI NG FROM THE CONSUMER' an accommodation, advantage, or privilege — no matching param key in the pricing-competition vocabulary
prohibition param is lossy: the text bans both personalized dynamic pricing (personal-data-based, incl. AI) and surveillance-personal-data pricing; 'surveillance-pricing' is the closest single enum

Plain-text extraction retains inline amendment markup (struck vs. inserted words indistinguishable, e.g. § 13-321(B) and Section 2's effective-date clause reading 'shall take effect from the date it is enacted shall take effect October 1, 2026'); coded values rely on the final-reading language

entries.appliesTo: food retailers with employees under an existing collective bargaining agreement or memorandum of understanding

sources.enforcer: Labor & Employment § 4-406(C) — 'A PERSON MAY BRING AN ACTION TO RECOVER FO R INJURY OR LOSS' sustained as a result of a violation of this section; § 4-406(D) — court may award reasonable attorney's fees
